properties.site-address: Land at Clockhouse and Access House, Imperial Street, Bromley-by-Bow
properties.notes: Full planning application for the demolition of the existing buildings on site and the construction of a residential-led mixed use scheme comprising a series of buildings ranging from one to 27 storeys in height to provide 3,570 sq m of flexible community, commercial and retail floorspace (Use Classes A1, A2, A3, A4, B1 and/or D1) at ground and mezzanine floor level, 491 residential units (Use Class C3) on the upper floors, parking/refuse/servicing at basement and ground floor, energy centre, communal amenity areas, and all associated landscaped public open space.
